open_points: SWE1-05: Upstream HSI contract NOT_PROVIDED, creating a gap in bidirectional upstream-to-SWE.1 traceability.
SWE1-06: Verification criterion not documented in software_requirements.md; only the source and test verification are mentioned, no explicit verification criteria for the requirement.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the key value 0x0000AAAA to the IWDG_KR.KEY field when refreshing the watchdog counter.
requirements.verification: Host unit test passes when the register array at ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_KR_OFFSET/4U] contains the value 0x0000AAAA after a call to the refresh function.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the key value 0x00005555 to the IWDG_KR.KEY field when enabling write-accesses to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR registers.
requirements.verification: Host unit test passes when the register array at ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_KR_OFFSET/4U] contains the value 0x00005555 after a call to the enable write-access function.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the key value 0x0000CCCC to the IWDG_KR.KEY field when starting the watchdog.
requirements.verification: Host unit test passes when the register array at ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_KR_OFFSET/4U] contains the value 0x0000CCCC after a call to the start watchdog function.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write a value different from 0x5555 to the IWDG_KR.KEY field when disabling write-accesses to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR registers.
requirements.verification: Host unit test passes when the register array at ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_KR_OFFSET/4U] contains a value other than 0x00005555 after a call to disable write-access function.
